---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new fit, option or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like fitpo to do?**
A short description of the feature.

**Why is it useful?**
The problem it solves, e.g. a type of pushover curve the current fits don't
handle well. A reference to the method, if there is one, helps.

**Alternatives you have considered**
Any workaround you use now.
